title: Kat P Probable NDE 7269
content: While on the ventilator I remember seeing my hands so swollen, I said to myself, 'Oh sh#$, I'm septic.' Then I saw my friend holding the catheter. The urine was so dark. I said again, 'Oh no, multi-system failure!' Then it happened. I found myself fully aware and present, yet all that I could see was the most beautiful of all-consuming light, everywhere just the light. It was like the center of a flame. I had an overwhelming feeling of ok-ness, like more than love, more than peace and beyond serenity. It was so good that words cannot describe it. Then I heard my own voice say, 'But he is only 9,' referring to my son. It was a moment of doubt. In that instant, the light was gone and I was sitting in my hospital room. It was my same room but I was sitting up in subdued light. I was free of all equipment. I could literally feel the bed and feel my being. I felt confused, yet amazed. Then there was a knock on my window. I laughed because I knew I was on the second floor. I put my hand over my eyes still laughing, and said 'Okay, I will go along, come in.' When I opened my eyes my Grandfather was standing at the foot of my bed. He was nodding, 'No,' while shaking his finger in a no-no manner. I wanted to touch him to talk to him. Before I could speak a word or ask a question, I was back in my bed. I could hear my friend say, 'Oh, she is drooling,' while gently wiping my face. She since told me that happened days before I woke up. When I did wake, I cried for weeks. At times, still I wonder if I made the right choice. I feel that I have drifted through the cosmos before yet can't remember when. I have such a strong desire to go there, yet I do not want to leave those I love. I settle in the knowledge that one day I will go there again. I don't often admit that this was the most wonderful beautiful experience of my entire life.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: On a ventilator; experiencer perceived sepsis and multi-system failure.

stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Medical-room awareness preceded an all-consuming light; later a hospital-room scene with a deceased grandfather occurred, followed by return to the body.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: After the light vanished, experiencer reported sitting up in the same hospital room in subdued light, free of equipment, feeling the bed and their being; then a knock on the window on the second floor; grandfather appeared at the foot of the bed nodding 'No' and shaking his finger.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I found myself fully aware and present, yet all that I could see was the most beautiful of all-consuming light, everywhere just the light.” “It was like the center of a flame.” “It was so good that words cannot describe it.” “But he is only 9.” “At times, still I wonder if I made the right choice.”
